answers.workaround:
It can be worked around using `_get_property_list`:
```gdscript
extends Node

var data: Array

func _get_property_list():
	# Export `data` property, but don't show it in inspector.
	# (`data` property will be saved in the scene file.)
	var serializable = [
		{
			name = "data",
			usage = PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR,
			type = TYPE_ARRAY,
		},
	]
	return serializable
```

title: Ability to declare exported properties that are not shown (aka hidden) in inspector
